summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch view, coordinate array) pairs with inline coordinate computation and an updated docstring; set_rnd skips keys starting with "__"); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter generator with ensure_tuple-normalized start_pos and NumpyPadMode validation; reworked GridPatchDataset taking dataset, patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates, with a NotImplementedError for missing length, numpy ceil worker split, per-patch apply_transform, and coordinate toggle; PatchDataset docstring np.float -> float; math import removed); monai/data/__init__.py exports PatchIter; docs/source/data.rst adds a PatchIter autodoc entry; tests/test_grid_dataset.py adds TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array using the pinned values. Verification was by reading only: no tests were run, and the pinned values and docstring example output were checked by hand, not executed. Nothing was committed. Remaining step: run pytest tests/test_grid_dataset.py to confirm.
